title: Influence of loading and grafting on hard-and soft-tissue healing at immediately placed implants: An experimental study in minipigs
authors: Parvini P, Buser D, Pippenger BE, Imber JC, Stavropoulos A, Bellón B, Jarry C, Schwarz F. J Clin Periodontol. 2023 Feb;50(2):232-241. doi: 10.1111/jcpe.13734.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Implant loading and grafting had no major effects on osseointegration and peri-implant soft tissue healing at TLX implants” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
